# FG-DOC-0002

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_bounded_doc_index_is_never_a_silent_pass` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 文書が多すぎるか大きすぎるため、一部しか検査できていません。結果は読めた範囲のものです。
- en: Only part of the documents could be checked: there are too many, or they are too large. The results are about what was read.
- id: Hanya sebagian dokumen yang dapat diperiksa: terlalu banyak atau terlalu besar. Hasilnya hanya untuk bagian yang terbaca.

## 原因 (cause)

Reading a revision's documents for the document lint stops at its bounds rather than run unbounded, and says so instead of passing. Server (`forge/doc-lint`, forge-checks doc_lint DocLimits): the head's tree listing over 50000 entries or 8 MiB (`doc_tree`), more than 2000 `.md` files (`doc_files`), a `.md` over 4 MiB (`doc_file_too_large`: not read), more than 32 MiB of `.md` in all (`doc_bytes`), more than 64 type definitions (`doctype_files`); the run concludes `neutral` when it found no problem (a broken reference alone is no failure then: the target may be in what was not read). Client (`gstn doc lint` / `gstn doc fmt`, forge-client doc): more than 5000 `.md` files (`doc_files`), more than 64 MiB of `.md` (`doc_bytes`), a `git ls-files` listing over 16 MiB (`doc_tree`), more than 64 type definitions (`doctype_files`), or a file name that is not UTF-8 (`path_not_utf8`); gstn exits 1 with this code when it found no other problem. Not a server fault.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The run's summary (server) or the warning line on stderr / `incomplete.reason` in --json (gstn) names the bound. Count the Markdown files: git ls-files '*.md' | wc -l. The job's log event `forge.spec_index.recorded` carries `doc_incomplete` with `request_id`.

## 対処 (fix)

Keep the repository within the bounds: fewer or smaller Markdown files (split a large document; plan 13 §8.2 suggests at most 1500 lines), or move generated Markdown out of the repository. Nothing to change on the server.
